مَوْجٌ , [a coll. gen. n., Waves; billows; surges; or a collection of waves;] water rising above other water: (TA:) pl. أَمْوَاجٌ: (S, K, Msb:) مَوْجَةٌ has a more special signification; [namely, a wave, a single wave;] and the pl. of this, which is the n. un., is مَوْجَاتٌ. (Msb.) ―
-b2- فَرَسٌ غَوْجٌ مَوْجٌ: see art. غوج. موج is here an imitative sequent. (TA.) ―
-b3- مَوْجَةُ الشَّبَابِ (tropical:) The prime of youth. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
